5.text: My mother had fallen ill on a visit to Monqiz. She was in a medical suite at the royal hospital there.

6.text: I immediately asked for the helicopter to be prepared. In a few moments, we were in the air.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I feared for the worst as we landed on the helipad on top of the hospital. I rushed downstairs and approached the door to the suite.

9.speaker: Narrator

13.speaker: Narrator

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: There she was, standing and waving at me.

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Mother. Would you care to tell me why I'm here?"

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: I walked up to her. She seemed perfectly healthy.

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "What's happened to you? I came as soon as I got the call."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "You'd better really be sick. Otherwise, you're just wasting my time."

23.speaker: Estela Toras
23.text: "Because you're a good son who trusts his mother, even when she feigns an illness to lure him out to Monqiz."

24.speaker: Estela Toras
24.text: "Time is of the essence. Come on. I'll tell you everything on the way."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "You'll tell me now, or I won't go anywhere."

29.speaker: Estela Toras
29.text: "I know how stubborn you male Torases are. But now that I have your attention, I need you to take me seriously."

30.speaker: Estela Toras
30.text: "Listen. Don't ask me how I got this information, but there's a coup attempt in the works."

31.speaker: Estela Toras
31.text: "But we're getting out of here. The day I let anything bad happen to my only son is the day the sea worms eat my bones."

32.speaker: Estela Toras
32.text: "Come now. The boat is waiting. I've handled everything. Your luggage is loaded and departure is imminent."

80.speaker: Estela Toras
80.text: "Oh, your uncle's always been able to fend for himself in these situations."

81.speaker: Estela Toras
81.text: "He and his brute of a son will be just fine."

82.speaker: Estela Toras

83.speaker: Estela Toras

84.speaker: Estela Toras
84.text: "She's on the boat, waiting for us."

85.speaker: Estela Toras
85.text: "Thank Dast she came to her dear old grandma's aid."

90.speaker: Estela Toras
90.text: "That damn girl is still nowhere to be found."

91.speaker: Estela Toras
91.text: "I had such high hopes for her. But I'm sure that wherever she is now, she's safer than she would be in Rizia."

93.speaker: Estela Toras

94.speaker: Estela Toras
94.text: "Did you not hear the part where I told you your life was in danger?"

97.speaker: Player_Romus

99.speaker: Estela Toras

100.speaker: Estela Toras

101.speaker: Estela Toras
101.text: "You can't. Not without risking your hide."

102.speaker: Narrator

105.speaker: Estela Toras

110.speaker: Estela Toras
110.text: "Damn the Kingdom! You are my only son!"

111.speaker: Estela Toras
111.text: "Damn your pride! You are my only son!"

113.speaker: Estela Toras
113.text: "I forbid you from making such a colossally stupid mistake!"

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "Don't you worry. I will be fine."

117.speaker: Estela Toras
117.text: "How can I be all right? I can't. I won't."

119.speaker: Estela Toras
119.text: "Thankfully, you have a bit of me in you."

218.speaker: Estela Toras
218.text: "And no, I won't accept no for an answer."

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "I order you to leave. As your King."

220.speaker: Player_Romus

221.speaker: Estela Toras
221.text: "I am telling you, it is confirmed!"

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: She gave me an ominous look.

225.speaker: Estela Toras
225.text: "What I'd like is for our family to be far away from this mess."

226.speaker: Estela Toras
226.text: "That's exactly what your father told me in 1926."

231.speaker: Estela Toras
231.text: "Ah. That. Sorry, darling. I didn't mean to worry you."

240.speaker: Estela Toras
240.text: "Believe it or not, we have been invited to the royal court of Queen Beatrice."

241.speaker: Estela Toras
241.text: "Say what you will about that woman -- and I've said plenty. But when her in-laws' lives are on the line, she delivers."

242.speaker: Estela Toras
242.text: "I did warn you not to go splashing your relationship all over the Rizian news. But now that you're about to be ousted, it hardly matters."

249.speaker: Estela Toras
249.text: "Oh, sweetheart. I think that ship sailed for you a long time ago."

250.speaker: Estela Toras
250.text: "This one, though, isn't leaving the harbor without you on it."

257.speaker: Lucita Azaro

268.speaker: Player_Romus

268.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Lucita"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Taddeus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_LucitaExileConvo_NoWarning"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_Coup_Warning_Lucita"] == true) == false)

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "I admit, dear, I half-expected you to  attempt to get rid of me yourself."

270.speaker: Lucita Azaro
270.text: "He was new to the Council. Perhaps he was still getting accustomed to his position when..."

272.speaker: Lucita Azaro
272.text: "But whoever is behind this took deep pains to hide their activities from the Azaros. They knew we were in league with the Crown."

273.speaker: Lucita Azaro
273.text: "I know, and I'm sorry. My... condition must have dulled my instincts."

274.speaker: Lucita Azaro
274.text: "He's made of sturdy stuff. Just like his mother."

275.speaker: Lucita Azaro
275.text: "It won't be easy growing up as a prince in exile. But he'll have his parents with him."

280.speaker: Lucita Azaro
280.text: "And when he's all grown up, he'll come back to Rizia and take what's his."

281.speaker: Lucita Azaro
281.text: "And it might not be long before we all return home and take what's ours."

282.speaker: Narrator
282.text: She let out a long, loud laugh.

283.speaker: Lucita Azaro
283.text: "Don't be silly. If I wanted you gone, you'd be gone."

284.speaker: Lucita Azaro
284.text: "Besides, we can't have {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} growing up without a father."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "I can't believe Lucita Azaro would leave Rizia without a fight."

286.speaker: Lucita Azaro
286.text: "A less pregnant me would've stuck around and fought. But I can't risk it now."

287.speaker: Lucita Azaro
287.text: "It feels like just yesterday we were celebrating our triumph over Pales. All for nothing..."

294.speaker: Lucita Azaro
294.text: "All that bloodshed in Pales, just to wind up as exiles..."

296.speaker: Lucita Azaro
296.text: "Everything we've been through over the last eight years, just to wind up as exiles..."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "A fresh start, a fresh family. I'm looking forward to this."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "How could it be worse! I've lost everything!"

300.speaker: Narrator

302.speaker: Lucita Azaro
302.text: "Whatever's waiting for us when this boat docks, we'll handle it together."

303.speaker: Narrator
303.text: She put my hand on her stomach. I felt the thud of a little foot kicking against it.

304.speaker: Narrator
304.text: She put my hand on her stomach. I felt the thud of a little foot kicking against it.

305.speaker: Lucita Azaro

346.speaker: Pabel Adria
346.text: "They're not particularly tolerant of my kind over in Rumburg. But I'll make do."

347.speaker: Pabel Adria
347.text: "Kyrute's rather more accepting of my kind than Rizia ever was. Of course, it's no Derdia."

348.speaker: Pabel Adria
348.text: "Of course. I was as shocked by the whole affair as you were."

349.speaker: Pabel Adria
349.text: "Two Toras monarchs, two plots to get rid of them. I'm glad you survived this one."

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "Now that I'm no longer King, I can finally do the one thing I've been wanting to do forever."

353.speaker: Narrator
353.text: Time stood still as he kissed me back.

357.speaker: Pabel Adria
357.text: "Hmm. I'm sure it'll be a page-turner."

358.speaker: Pabel Adria
358.text: "In my opinion, even commoners should refrain from that."

359.speaker: Pabel Adria
359.text: "You do have the face for it."

362.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
362.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Relations_PabelFriend"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Turn_Pabel"] == true) == false

363.speaker: Player_Romus
363.text: "I've got to go check on my luggage. Don't you move a muscle."

365.speaker: Pabel Adria
365.text: "I hope I can be of some assistance to you during your time away from home."

367.speaker: Pabel Adria
367.text: "It took an overthrow to get His Majesty out of the closet."

369.speaker: Pabel Adria
369.text: "The new regime will put Rizia's old anti-homosexuality laws back in place in a heartbeat."

371.speaker: Pabel Adria
371.text: "No. But we get what few others like us do. A chance for a new start."

376.speaker: Pabel Adria
376.text: "God, no. All those orchards, all that upkeep. I'll be happy if I never see another apple tree in my life."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "You don't have to butler for me anymore. You can do whatever you want."
377.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelLoverExileConvo_MissRizia"] == false)

378.speaker: Pabel Adria
378.text: "I'll find a new vocation eventually, I'm sure."

379.speaker: Pabel Adria
379.text: "But I do hope they still call me 'Lord Adria' where we're going. I've gotten used to it."

380.speaker: Pabel Adria
380.text: "But someone's got to tell the staff at our destination how you take your tea. And I'm still not convinced you know how to knot your own ties."

384.speaker: Pabel Adria
384.text: "You really are a different person at sea, aren't you?"

385.speaker: Narrator
385.text: He uncorked a bottle and poured me a glass. I drank deeply, savoring the taste.

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: He turned to face me. He had a wistful look in his eyes.

394.speaker: Vina Toras
394.text: "I didn't. I got the same call that you did, that Grandmother was in the emergency room."

399.speaker: Vina Toras
399.text: "I wasn't sure at first. I got the same call that you did, that Grandmother was in the emergency room."

400.speaker: Vina Toras
400.text: "Then I heard that my own fiance's family might be trying to overthrow us..."

404.speaker: Vina Toras
404.text: "Then I heard that Manus' family might be trying to overthrow us..."

405.speaker: Vina Toras
405.text: "Then I heard our lives were in danger..."

409.speaker: Estela Toras
409.text: "Safe in Pales for now. She and Duke Reinhart may join us if the climate worsens there."

414.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
414.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Husband"] == false) == false

415.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Husband"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == false) == false)

416.speaker: Vina Toras
416.text: "Grandmother wouldn't let me get word to him. But he's not involved in whatever's happening. He can't be."

417.speaker: Vina Toras
417.text: "Grandmother wouldn't let me get word to him. But she assured me that Manus would meet us at our destination."

427.speaker: Vina Toras
427.text: "God only knows. Probably riding a horse through the streets of Porte Drazon, shooting anyone who looks at him funny."

428.speaker: Vina Toras
428.text: "God only knows. I'm happy to leave him behind."

429.speaker: Vina Toras
429.text: "Well. You know Grandmother. She hustled me onto the boat before I could ask any more questions."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "You should be happy. We're getting out of Rizia with our heads."

431.speaker: Vina Toras
431.text: "We shouldn't have had to leave at all."

433.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
433.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Vina"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true

434.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
434.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Vina"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) == false

435.speaker: Vina Toras
435.text: "But now if I so much as step onto Rizian soil again, your wife will have me killed on sight so precious {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} can claim his spot as heir."
435.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Vina"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true

436.speaker: Vina Toras
436.text: "There was so much I wanted to do, so much I could have been... it's all over now."
436.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Vina"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) == false

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "Once we're in Kyrute, you have my full blessing to be with Manus."
440.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CoupWarning_Destination_Kyrute"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true)) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_WhatWillYouDo"] == false)

441.speaker: Narrator
441.text: She gave me a look of pure scorn.

442.speaker: Vina Toras
442.text: "Your blessing means nothing, Father! You're no one! And so am I."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "What will you do when we get there?"

446.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
446.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CoupWarning_Destination_Kyrute"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true)) == false

447.speaker: Vina Toras
447.text: "I'll try to find Manus, of course. After that...""

448.speaker: Vina Toras
448.text: "I don't know. There's a terrible freedom in having the burden of expectations lifted all at once."
448.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CoupWarning_Destination_Kyrute"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true)) == false

452.speaker: Vina Toras
452.text: "Of course, there's one burden I'll always have to bear. That of rightful successor to the throne of Rizia."

453.speaker: Player_Romus
453.text: "Someday, you'll come back and claim what is yours."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "I'm sorry, Vina. You never asked for any of this."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "Yes. We'll never fully be out of danger until the day we die."

456.speaker: Vina Toras
456.text: "But I'll never fully shake the burden of being Princess of Rizia."

457.speaker: Vina Toras
457.text: "But what if I don't want to?"

458.speaker: Vina Toras
458.text: "Neither did you. Nor your father. Nor any of us."

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "Nobody has to know who you are. You can walk among the common people if you want to."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "I expect you to show the same exemplary service to me that you did back in Porte Drazon."
485.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Lucita"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Murder"] == false)

487.text: "Of course, the number of staff at your disposal will be significantly smaller than at Pales Rezna. But we'll make do."

503.speaker: Narrator
503.text: His face was flushed. He smiled shyly.

504.speaker: Pabel Adria
504.text: "I believe a little time out of the Kingdom will do us both a world of good."

508.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
508.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_WantedToDo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Outed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Murder"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Thanks"] == true) == false

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "I've got to go check on my luggage. I'll see you at supper."
509.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_WantedToDo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Outed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Murder"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PabelButlerExileConvo_Thanks"] == true)

510.speaker: Pabel Adria
510.text: "Six thirty on the dot. I've made sure they brought that wine you like."

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "I'm not quite done exploring the boat yet."

515.speaker: Pabel Adria
515.text: "Go on. We've got all the time in the world."

517.speaker: Pabel Adria
517.text: "That aside, though, I would accompany you to the ends of the earth."

531.speaker: Player_Romus
531.text: "I've got to go check on my luggage. Don't you move a muscle."

533.speaker: Pabel Adria
533.text: "Go on. We have all the time in the world."

553.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
553.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_WhatWillYouDo"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_ShouldBeHappy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Husband"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Thanks"] == true

554.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
554.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_WhatWillYouDo"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_ShouldBeHappy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Husband"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Thanks"] == true) == false

558.speaker: Vina Toras
558.text: "I love you, Father. But this will take some getting used to."

559.speaker: Narrator
559.text: I left her cabin. The door clicked shut.

562.speaker: Narrator
562.text: She walked down the hall of the yacht. I looked around at my surroundings.

563.speaker: Narrator
563.text: I sat down in a cushioned armchair and let the weight of what was happening sink in.

564.speaker: Player_Romus
564.text: "All right. I don't need to know any more."
564.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_AreYouSure"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_Destination"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_HowToLive"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_HugoRico"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_LeaveCountry"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_Vina"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_Lucita"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_Pabel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Reform_Coup_Azaro"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Reform_Coup_Azaro"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Failed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Failed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false)

565.speaker: Estela Toras
565.text: "The kingdom is big enough for us to fly under the radar. And we'll get to keep the lavish lifestyles to which we are so accustomed."

566.speaker: Player_Romus
566.text: "I have to go now. But let's talk more later."
566.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_WhatWillYouDo"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_ShouldBeHappy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Husband"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Thanks"] == true

567.speaker: Vina Toras
567.text: "I'd like to be left alone for a minute, anyway."

572.speaker: Vina Toras
572.text: "Then I heard that my own husband's family might be trying to overthrow us..."
572.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == false) == false)

573.speaker: Estela Toras
573.text: "And wouldn't you know it? In the end, he was right."

574.speaker: Estela Toras
574.text: "But if confronting it is the only way to keep us together, I'll settle for that."

575.speaker: Estela Toras
575.text: "My king for how much longer, darling?"

580.speaker: Player_Romus
580.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Reform_Coup_Azaro"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Reform_Coup_Azaro"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Failed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Rescue_Failed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_Adopted"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.CoupWarning_Bruno"] == true)

582.speaker: Estela Toras
582.text: "I'm so sorry, dear, but I had to leave him at the palace. Why would the Queen Mother bring the King's mutt to Monqiz? It would've raised too many questions."

583.speaker: Estela Toras
583.text: "I'm sure he'll be taken good care of over there."

587.speaker: Player_Romus
587.text: "I am not leaving without my dog."

588.speaker: Estela Toras
588.text: "We'll send for the damn dog! Won't you listen to reason?!"

592.speaker: Player_Romus
592.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_VinaExileConvo_Husband"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == false)

593.speaker: Estela Toras
593.text: "Don't be foolish, son. I brought you here to save your life."

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "This again? If you'll recall, I made my attitude towards traitors very clear on your birthday."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "Never a dull moment for us royals, is there?"

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "My uncle is out of the picture. Who else could possibly replace me on the throne?"

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "This must be Hugo's doing. Who else could possibly replace me on the throne?"

607.speaker: Player_Romus
607.text: "This again? Trust me, the danger is exaggerated."

608.speaker: Player_Romus
608.text: "Sorry, but I do have to ask. Where did you get this information?"

609.speaker: Estela Toras
609.text: "Haven't I told you already? A cup of tea with a viscount's wife is more effective than a dozen intelligence agents. Cheaper, too."

610.speaker: Estela Toras
610.text: "So you were warned before? And you didn't tell your dear old mother?"

611.speaker: Estela Toras
611.text: "It seems someone didn't get the message."

612.speaker: Estela Toras
612.text: "The guillotine waiting for us in Porte Drazon is anything but dull."

613.speaker: Estela Toras
613.text: "I doubt poor Hugo would've moved a muscle against you. But there are others..."

614.speaker: Estela Toras
614.text: "I always did have a bad feeling about that man."

619.speaker: Player_Romus
619.text: "Enough of your melodrama, Mother. I'm going home now."

621.speaker: Estela Toras
621.text: "If my intuition is right, this goes deeper than either of us know. We can't trust anyone back at the palace."

625.speaker: Estela Toras
625.text: "He and the other Torases will be just fine."

629.speaker: Estela Toras
629.text: "You neutered his house, remember? He's not the target. We are."

633.speaker: Narrator
633.text: I knocked on the door. No answer came.

635.speaker: Player_Romus
635.text: "We're going to be stuck together on this boat for the next few days. You'll have to talk to me sooner or later."

636.speaker: Player_Romus
636.text: "They're trying to kill us, Vina. Your petty inheritance grievances don't matter."

637.speaker: Player_Romus
637.text: "Take all the time you need. I'll be around."

639.speaker: Narrator
639.text: The door stayed closed. I stepped away from it.

641.speaker: Player_Romus
641.text: "I've heard the rumors too, and I'm as worried as you are."

645.speaker: Player_Romus
645.text: "I'm sorry I didn't heed your warnings any sooner."

646.speaker: Lucita Azaro
646.text: "I admit I'm hurt that you'd listen to your mother and not me."

647.speaker: Lucita Azaro
647.text: "But I'm just glad that you came to your senses in time."

651.speaker: Pabel Adria
651.text: "The Sazons may outwardly tolerate homosexuality, but they'll be under a lot of pressure to reinstate the old laws."

655.speaker: Pabel Adria
655.text: "Six thirty on the dot. I've made sure they brought that sparkling grape juice you like."
